name: Cyprus
description: Cyprus from the copper of the Bronze Age to Greeks, Romans, Venice, the Ottomans and Britain, independence in 1960, division in 1974 and the EU.

checkpoints.name: Ancient Cyprus
checkpoints.note: Stone Age villages, copper mining, Greek kingdoms and then Persian, Ptolemaic, Roman and Byzantine rule. Zeno, the founder of Stoicism, came from Kition.

checkpoints.name: Crusaders and Venice
checkpoints.note: The Lusignans ruled a crusader kingdom for three hundred years, and Venice took the island in 1489.

checkpoints.name: Ottoman and British rule
checkpoints.note: The Ottomans took Cyprus in 1571. Britain ran it from 1878, and EOKA fought for union with Greece.

checkpoints.name: Independence and division
checkpoints.note: Cyprus became independent in 1960. A coup and the Turkish invasion of 1974 divided the island, and the Republic joined the EU in 2004.
